corrections: Dedicated D-model loft, tandem canopy, fixed glove and pivoted wings, separated chamfered nacelles with raked open intake ducts, F110 nozzle petals and correctly rear-facing exhaust interiors.
Repositioned wing plane and intake mouths against orthographic drawings; removed oversized aft glove and floating nacelle seam outlines. Separate rudders no longer overlap the fixed fin.
Distinct D pilot twin-MFD panel and later RIO DD/PTID/right-MFD arrangement, individual standby clusters, HUD glass and housing, knee panels, seats, harnesses and labeled console groups.

Recessed moving horizon cards behind actual panel apertures after seated renders exposed mask occlusion. Live TAS, geometric altitude, signed readout, climb, attitude, true heading and pilot AoA/sweep pointers; unavailable values blank.

Shared expressions drive mirrored wing sweep, differential stabilators, roll spoilers, flaps, stick, throttles, pedals, gear lamps and gear. Main gear folds inward; nose launch bar folds during retraction and no longer enters the footwell.
Selected geometric fastener rows, access seams and rescue/danger stencils; no external stores. RIO has display hand-controller rather than duplicated pilot controls.
independentDimensions: D manual length62ft8.5in (19.1135m); extended span64ft1.5in (19.5463m), height16ft (4.8768m). Runtime bounds include small seam thickness and canted fin effects.
SAC wheelbase276.35in (7.01929m) and main track197in (5.0038m). Wing movement checked from20degrees to68degrees against dashed planform and approximately38ft2.4in swept span.

Uniform cockpit scale from approximately72mm pilot and80mm rear small instrument faces. Interior width, depth and seat positions are reconstructed. SAC top length is about2% inconsistent with span scale; diagram not stretched.
reviewNotes.visual: Inspected current-hash side/top/front/68degree-sweep overlays and separate pilot/RIO panel overlays; eight standard exterior/operator/cabin renders; ten instrument/detail states. Final captures were re-inspected in six contact sheets after exhaust normal and launch-bar corrections, following full-resolution inspection of previous iterations.
limitations: Polygonal F-14D interpretation combining July1985 preservice SAC exterior dimensions with later D photographs and PTID-equipped RIO foldout. Small planform and canopy contour discrepancies remain; uniform overlays disclose them.

Panel positions follow the foldouts, but display symbology, dial scales, switch counts, side-console spacing, seat details, gear mechanisms and selected fastener/seam positions remain approximations. Not a complete rivet or systems reproduction.

Airspeed is TAS, altitude geometric and heading true. No pitot/static IAS/Mach/pressure altimetry or magnetic navigation. Engine core RPM, temperature, oil, fuel, radar altitude, navigation and radar data are unavailable and blank/INOP.
HUD is physical glass without collimated symbology. RIO display hand-controller and console switches are static; no weapons functions.

20–68degree sweep is an illustrative TAS-based visual schedule with smoothing, not the real Mach-based air-data computer; kernel aerodynamics do not change with span. No75degree parking oversweep or sweep/flap interlock.
Simplified shared flight dynamics and gear retraction; flight smoke demonstrates controllability, not real F-14 performance. No external stores.
Publicly hosted D flight manual carries reproduction restrictions: reference pixels are local study evidence only. Public-domain Navy photos are cited but not embedded as textures.
